offer.title: Is an inspection worth paying for?
offer.intro: An inspection costs only a small share of the car’s price. If you decide not to buy the car after it, you’ll most likely have saved more than you paid for the inspection.
offer.slider_label: Price of the car you are considering
offer.result: of the car’s price is what a full inspection costs
offer.item_body_text: We measure paint thickness and look for repainted panels, filler, corrosion and other signs of repair.
offer.item_mechanics_text: We inspect the engine, gearbox and cooling system, then check the suspension, brakes, steering, tyres and fluids.
offer.item_electronics_text: We read fault codes and live data from the control units and compare the mileage stored in them with the dashboard.
offer.item_drive: Test drive, when it is safe
offer.item_drive_text: When conditions are safe, we take the car on the road to see how the engine, gearbox, brakes and steering behave while driving.
offer.item_report: Report with photos and a verdict
offer.item_report_text: After the inspection we send photos, a description of what we found and a clear verdict on whether the car is worth buying.
